tasks.short: Plan the department budget and produce the financial reports.

steps.what: Pull actuals and commitments for the budget.
Retype actuals into the budget spreadsheet.
Decide budget cuts and moves with finance.
Write the commentary on the financial report.

loop.input: Actuals pack and the budget decision
loop.output: Commentary sentences, each tied to a cost-centre figure
loop.check: Administrator deletes any sentence whose figure is not on the pack
loop.stop: One draft. A cost centre with no decision note gets a figure and no adjective.
loop.why_not_simpler: Commentary has to follow the meeting, which is not a report layout

steps.what: File the approved financial report in the pack.

tasks.design: The {ERP} actuals view is the budget source. Retyping those figures into a side sheet stops. The administrator and the finance officer still decide cuts and moves. A bounded pass drafts commentary only from those figures, and the financial report is filed only from the meeting decision plus the checked commentary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actuals were retyped into a workbook before anyone could see the year, and the commentary was written loose of the figures.
tasks.enabler_now: The finance system can save a cost-centre actuals view, so the retype is no longer the path to a report.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing cuts and moves, and stopping commentary that the figures do not support.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator decides the departmental moves within the delegated limit. The pack does not decide them.

ambition.what: A mid-year move of money between two named cost centres while the year still has months left.

tasks.altitude: The retype is gone. The finance meeting stays. The administrator can hold a report whose commentary does not match the agreed figures.

reach.task: Explain a variance in a periodic report
reach.learn: Which commentary lines must be tied to a figure before the pack goes out

evidence.claim: A departmental budget report can be assembled from ledger actuals once cost centres are mapped. The move itself is a decision.
Commentary drafted from figures still has to be checked against those figures by a person.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: departmental planning, control and the financial report. The institution's statutory accounts are out of scope.

Structured fields: cost centre, account, period, actual, commitment, decision (hold, cut, move), amount. The finance system produces actuals. If a cost centre is unmapped, that line stays on a short exception list and is not given a generated sentence.
Use the finance system's own budget report and export before any custom job. The side sheet is not rebuilt.
Amounts above the administrator's delegated limit wait for the finance director. That approval is outside this task.
unknowns: The delegated limit for a departmental move.
Whether cost centres in the finance system match the department's own names.
Who receives the financial report pack.
research_questions: Does the finance system already store a budget version, or only actuals?
Which moves require a second signer?

incremental.description: Maintain the cost-centre map when the chart of accounts changes

approvals.approved_version: budget moves agreed in the finance meeting
commentary checked against the agreed figures
budget moves agreed in the finance meeting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many lines are unmapped, so the meeting rebuilds the picture and commentary is rewritten. High: cost centres are stable, the retype stays gone, and commentary is a short check. The meeting stays. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Formulate the institution's strategic plan with its leadership.

steps.what: Gather enrolment and finance signals for planning.
Hold strategy workshops with deans and faculty.
Draft the institution strategic plan from workshop notes.

loop.input: Workshop notes and the planning signals
loop.output: Plan sections, each tied to a note or a signal
loop.check: Administrator removes any aim that the notes do not contain
loop.stop: One draft. An aim with no note is dropped, not invented.
loop.why_not_simpler: Workshop notes are prose. A template cannot know which aim the room chose

steps.what: Present the strategic plan for adoption.
Adopt the institution strategic plan.
Publish the adopted strategic plan.

tasks.design: A {BI} pack of enrolment and {ERP} figures is ready before the workshops. A bounded pass drafts the strategic plan only from workshop notes and those figures. The board adopts the text. Publication to the {CMS} uses that voted text and no other.
tasks.previous_blocker: Strategy was written from slides and memory, and the figures were assembled the week of the workshop.
tasks.enabler_now: Enrolment and finance extracts can be refreshed, and a bounded pass can turn notes into a draft a person edits.
tasks.still_hard: The workshops and the board's choice of aims. Drafting help does not choose the strategy.
tasks.human_edge: The board adopts the plan. The administrator does not publish a version the board did not vote.
tasks.altitude: Workshops and the board meeting stay. Signals and a first draft are ready. The administrator gains the right to hold publication until the voted text is the one on the page. The aims themselves are not a new personal right.

reach.task: Draft an institution-wide plan from a leadership workshop
reach.learn: Which aims came from the room and which were only in the figures

evidence.claim: Strategy and curriculum work stay manual; drafting help is the limit, and no agent runs the plan.
A published plan that adds aims the workshop did not discuss will be wrong even if the prose is fluent.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: from the signal pack through board adoption and publication. Operational policies that follow the plan are a separate task.

Structured fields: year, enrolment count, cost-centre actual, workshop-note id, aim id. Institutional research produces the enrolment extract. If a figure has no source extract, it is not put in the plan.
Use the existing report views before a custom planning model. There is no planning model in this design.
The board member's time is not the administrator's saving.
unknowns: Who on the board may adopt the plan.
Which signal definitions institutional research already maintains.
Whether the plan is public or internal.
research_questions: Are enrolment definitions stable across years?
Is adoption a board minute or a signature on the document?

incremental.description: Refresh signal definitions before each planning round
Board secretariat files the signed copy

approvals.approved_version: strategic plan text the board voted
strategic plan text the board voted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: workshops dominate and the draft is rewritten in the room. High: signals are ready and the draft is edited, not restarted. Workshops and the board vote stay. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set operational policies and change them when operations change.

steps.what: Pull operations and demographics for the policy review.
Mark where current procedures miss the operations data.

loop.input: Current procedure text and the operations extract
loop.output: A gap list: procedure clause, extract row, and what is missing
loop.check: Administrator confirms each gap against the clause and the row
loop.stop: One pass. A clause with no extract is marked unknown, not non-compliant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Procedures are prose and the extract is a table, so a keyword search misses the mismatch

steps.what: Decide the operational policy change with the people affected.
Draft the operational procedure from the decision note.

loop.input: Policy decision note and the current procedure
loop.output: Revised procedure with changes limited to the decision note
loop.check: Administrator checks each change against the note
loop.stop: One draft. Text the note did not ask for is removed.
loop.why_not_simpler: The decision is a meeting note, not a redline

steps.what: Approve the operational policy version for use.
Publish the procedure and notify the affected staff.

tasks.design: Operations and enrolment figures sit in a {BI} view beside the procedure library in {DOCS}. A bounded pass lists where a procedure and the figures disagree, and another drafts only the changes the meeting agreed. {WORKFLOW} publishes that signed version and notifies staff. Staff-monitoring rules are not part of this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedures lived in files, and a change waited until someone noticed a mismatch by reading.
tasks.enabler_now: A versioned procedure library can hold owners and review dates, and a bounded pass can compare prose with a table.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding the change with the people who have to follow it, and refusing a gap the extract does not show.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator signs the version. A gap list is not a new rule.

ambition.what: Whether the registration procedure still matches this year's enrolment mix, at each term start.

tasks.altitude: The meeting stays. Evidence and a redline are ready. The administrator can refuse a procedure that goes beyond the decision note.

reach.task: Map a local procedure to an external rule
reach.learn: Which sentences are a quote of a rule and which are a local choice

evidence.claim: A versioned policy library can keep approvals and map procedure text to rules; a person still decides the change.
Choosing which local procedure to change is a judgement from this institution's operations.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: operational procedures of the department, from evidence to the published version. Regulatory filings are a separate task.
Structured fields: procedure id, version, owner, review date, clause id, evidence row id. Operations owners produce the log. If a figure has no owner, it is not used as evidence.
Configure the document store's versioning and the workflow tool's approval path before custom code.
Procedures that monitor staff, set rosters, or score behaviour are out of scope and need a separate works-council path where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which procedures have an owner and a review date today.
Whether demographics used as evidence are allowed for this purpose.
Who must be notified when a procedure changes.
research_questions: Are current procedures in one library or in personal files?
Which operational logs are already structured?

incremental.description: Keep review dates and clause owners on the procedure library

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the meeting rewrites the procedure and the evidence is incomplete. High: gaps are real, the draft follows the note, and the meeting stays. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Help faculty with classes, orientation, transcripts and events.

steps.what: Log faculty requests for class cover, transcripts and events.

loop.input: Faculty mail asking for cover, a transcript or an event
loop.output: A ticket typed as cover, transcript or event, with the date asked
loop.check: Administrator corrects the type before anyone acts
loop.stop: One pass. Ambiguous mail stays untyped for the administrator.
loop.why_not_simpler: The mail is free text and the three duties are different workflows

steps.what: Cover the teaching when faculty cannot take the class.
Run orientation programs for new students.
Issue transcripts from the student records system.
Schedule events and book the rooms requested.
Confirm the event booking to the requester.

tasks.design: Faculty mail becomes a {HELPDESK} ticket typed as class cover, a transcript or an event. Cover and orientation stay in person. Transcripts are issued from student records only after the administrator checks the record. Room bookings use the {CALENDAR}, and the confirmation matches that booking.
tasks.previous_blocker: The four duties arrived in the same mailbox and were handled by memory and retyping.
tasks.enabler_now: A helpdesk can route three request types, and the calendar already books rooms. The transcript is a record release, not a draft.
tasks.still_hard: Standing in for a class, and running orientation. Those are not tickets.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator releases a transcript only after seeing the student record. A ticket does not release it.

ambition.what: Visiting students get a transcript from the same checked record as degree students.

tasks.altitude: Class cover and orientation still take the time. Requests are sorted before the day starts. The administrator can refuse a transcript the record does not support.

reach.task: Arrange cover for an absent teacher
reach.learn: Which absences can be filled from a roster and which need a person in the room

evidence.claim: Official transcripts are released by a person from the student record, not from the wording of a request.
Class cover and orientation are presence, not a document workflow.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: faculty requests for cover, orientation, transcripts and event booking. Building the timetable is a separate task.
Structured fields: request id, type (cover, transcript, event), student id, room id, date. Faculty produce the request. If the type is unclear, it is not routed.
Student records in the step text means the institution's student information system.
Use the helpdesk types, the calendar's room booking and the student system's transcript print before custom code.
A transcript is not sent on an uncleared request. Manual fallback is the administrator printing from the record they opened.
unknowns: Who may authorise a transcript besides the administrator.
Whether visiting students are on the same student record.
Which rooms the calendar actually controls.
research_questions: Does the student system already print an official transcript?
Are cover requests distinguished from ordinary mail today?

incremental.description: Keep the request types and transcript release rules current

approvals.approved_version: transcript generated from the student record the administrator opened
event confirmation matching the booking on the calendar

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: class cover and orientation are the hours, and requests are messy. High: tickets are typed once, transcripts are a check, and events are a booking. Cover and orientation stay. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Budget retyping and procedure hunting shrink. Strategy workshops, the finance meeting, class cover and orientation stay. The administrator can hold a report, a plan or a procedure that is not the checked version.
reach: Compliance managers can reuse the procedure library, not the enrolment evidence
Investment fund managers can see a commentary line tied to a figure
skills_to_grow: Reading a cost-centre pack without rebuilding it
Marking a procedure gap only where the extract shows it
Releasing a transcript from the record, not from the request
role.ambitious_version: Each term starts with a budget pack, a procedure review against this year's enrolment, and a request queue that separates class cover from a transcript.
